name: Get Excel Table
description: Retrieve a table from an Excel spreadsheet stored in Sharepoint [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/table-range?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http)

configurable_props.name: alert
configurable_props.content:
Note: The table must exist within the Excel spreadsheet.
        
See Microsoft's documentation on how to [Create and Format a Table](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/create-and-format-tables-e81aa349-b006-4f8a-9806-5af9df0ac664)

configurable_props.name: itemId
configurable_props.label: Spreadsheet
configurable_props.description: **Search for the file by name.** Only xlsx files are supported.

configurable_props.name: tableName
configurable_props.label: Table Name
configurable_props.description: This is set in the **Table Design** tab of the ribbon

configurable_props.name: removeHeaders
configurable_props.label: Remove headers?
configurable_props.description: By default, The headers are included as the first row.

configurable_props.name: numberOfRows
configurable_props.label: Number of rows to return
configurable_props.description: Leave blank to return all rows.
